title.narrative: Number of annual land transactions registered, excluding first time registration (disaggregated by transfers, mortgages, leases andinheritance; disaggregated by gender)
Number of pilot service centers established, staffed and operational

Number of institutions with online link to LaoLandReg
Regulations or studies amended or produced
Number of Continuously Operating Reference Stations
Average cost of issuance of new land title
Districts with digital land information system (Lao LandReg) operational and in systematic use
Time taken to register a simple land transaction
Beneficiaries who participate in public awareness campaigns (disaggregated by ethnicity)
Number of old paper land records scanned, linked to Lao LandReg and archived.
Income generation to government through DOL (excluding first registration fees)
Coverage of cadastral index maps showing all land holdings, including communal lands.
Land titles or use certificates issued in Lao PDR (disaggregated by titles/certificates, gender and ethnicity)
Land titles or use certificates issued in name of women or jointly in Lao PDR (disaggregated by titles/certificates and ethnicity)
Titles or use rights in digital land information system (Lao LandReg)
Customer satisfaction with land administration services in selected offices (disaggregated by gender)
Female beneficiaries who participate in public awareness campaigns from total village population
